doctrine.role: House Tang institutional Tang Champion elite
principles: Tang Champion is a House Tang institutional rank and remains institutionally owned by House Tang regardless of temporary command assignment
Champion personnel preserve discipline, formation integrity, command continuity, trained personnel, assigned mounts, equipment, and cohesion
Champion assignments inherit mission-specific overlays from their lawful commander without changing institutional ownership
assignment to Tang Wei adds a protective-retinue mission but does not redefine every House Tang Champion as Tang Wei personal property
unassigned or newly promoted Champions remain in the House Tang Champion reserve until a lawful assignment transfers their formation membership

promotion into Tang Champion status transfers conserved integer headcount between aggregate House Tang cohorts; exact identity is created only when an individual later becomes mechanically or narratively relevant, without duplicating a body
